tasks.label: Keil: 增量编译 (Build)
args: $uv = 'C:\Users\LIAN\AppData\Local\Keil_v5\UV4\UV4.exe'; $proj = '${workspaceFolder}\MDK-ARM\POWER.uvprojx'; $log = '${workspaceFolder}\MDK-ARM\build_log.txt'; New-Item -ItemType File -Path $log -Force | Out-Null; Write-Host '>>> 开始 Keil 增量编译 (Build)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $p = Start-Process -FilePath $uv -ArgumentList "-b `"$proj`" -j0 -o `"$log`"" -PassThru; $n = 0; while (-not $p.HasExited) { $lines = @(Get-Content $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); while ($n -lt $lines.Count) { Write-Host $lines[$n]; $n++ }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50 }; $lines = @(Get-Content $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); while ($n -lt $lines.Count) { Write-Host $lines[$n]; $n++ }; Remove-Item $log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p.ExitCode -le 1) { Write-Host '>>> 编译成功!' -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 } else { Write-Host ">>> 编译失败 (ExitCode: $($p.ExitCode))" -ForegroundColor Red; exit $p.ExitCode }

tasks.label: Keil: 全量重编译 (Rebuild)
args: $uv = 'C:\Users\LIAN\AppData\Local\Keil_v5\UV4\UV4.exe'; $proj = '${workspaceFolder}\MDK-ARM\POWER.uvprojx'; $log = '${workspaceFolder}\MDK-ARM\build_log.txt'; New-Item -ItemType File -Path $log -Force | Out-Null; Write-Host '>>> 开始 Keil 全量重编译 (Rebuild)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $p = Start-Process -FilePath $uv -ArgumentList "-r `"$proj`" -j0 -o `"$log`"" -PassThru; $n = 0; while (-not $p.HasExited) { $lines = @(Get-Content $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); while ($n -lt $lines.Count) { Write-Host $lines[$n]; $n++ }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50 }; $lines = @(Get-Content $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); while ($n -lt $lines.Count) { Write-Host $lines[$n]; $n++ }; Remove-Item $log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p.ExitCode -le 1) { Write-Host '>>> 全量重编译成功!' -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 } else { Write-Host ">>> 全量重编译失败 (ExitCode: $($p.ExitCode))" -ForegroundColor Red; exit $p.ExitCode }

tasks.label: Keil: 下载烧录 (Flash)
args: $uv = 'C:\Users\LIAN\AppData\Local\Keil_v5\UV4\UV4.exe'; $proj = '${workspaceFolder}\MDK-ARM\POWER.uvprojx'; $log = '${workspaceFolder}\MDK-ARM\build_log.txt'; New-Item -ItemType File -Path $log -Force | Out-Null; Write-Host '>>> 开始烧录固件 (Flash)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $p = Start-Process -FilePath $uv -ArgumentList "-f `"$proj`" -o `"$log`"" -PassThru; $n = 0; while (-not $p.HasExited) { $lines = @(Get-Content $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); while ($n -lt $lines.Count) { Write-Host $lines[$n]; $n++ }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50 }; $lines = @(Get-Content $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); while ($n -lt $lines.Count) { Write-Host $lines[$n]; $n++ }; Remove-Item $log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p.ExitCode -eq 0) { Write-Host '>>> 烧录成功!' -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 } else { Write-Host ">>> 烧录失败 (ExitCode: $($p.ExitCode))" -ForegroundColor Red; exit $p.ExitCode }
